meta.subtitle: 美股熊市底部监控 / US Bear-Market Bottom Monitor

P0.label: Observation
P0.text: No stress cluster. Keep watching the seven dimensions.
P0.text_cn: 尚未出现压力聚集，继续观察七个维度。

P1.label: Panic clearing
P1.text: Fear is present across volatility, sentiment and breadth; risk has not cleared.
P1.text_cn: 波动率、情绪与市场宽度同时出现恐慌，风险尚未出清。

P2.label: Bottom brewing
P2.text: Credit, rates, breadth or price structure are starting to stabilise after panic.
P2.text_cn: 恐慌之后，信用、利率、宽度或价格结构开始企稳。

P3.label: Trend confirmed
P3.text: At least one confirmation path is established; the panic low is likely behind us.
P3.text_cn: 至少一条确认路径成立，恐慌低点大概率已过去。

phase_rules.P0: Default state: fewer than two fear conditions, or insufficient data.
phase_rules.P1: ≥ 2 of 3 fear conditions: VIX term structure, sentiment, breadth.
phase_rules.P2: ≥ 2 of 4 improvements (credit, rates, breadth, trend) AND a P1 episode in the last 120 sessions.
phase_rules.P3: ≥ 1 of 2 confirmations (breadth ≥ 50%, SPY above both 50/200DMA), price above its 50DMA, AND a P1 episode in the last 120 sessions.

meta.disclaimer: This is a condition detector, not a return forecast or a trading signal. It reports observable market states and their pre-registered rules. Educational research only — not investment advice.
data_notes: FRED and multpl serve latest-revised vintages, not real-time vintages.
CNN Fear & Greed has only about one year of public history; before that the sentiment check is NO DATA.
A failing source keeps its committed cache and is labelled KEPT CACHE, never silently filled.
